findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 6 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 79 questions numbered 1-79; by section: 6.1 7, 6.2 2, 6.3 11, 6.4 3, 6.5 3, 6.6 6, 6.7 4, 6.8 8, 6.9 16, 6.10 3, 6.11 10, 6.12 6.

Covers sections 6.1-6.12 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's examples and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (specific heat per gram, calorie content positive, SO₄²⁻ and the decreasing solubility of Group II sulphates, entropy increase alone does not decide spontaneity, ΔH°sol in the NaF cycle).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
